describe: make a scatter plot of two numbers against each other, to see if they go together
guide: Draw axes.scatter of one number column against another, and print their correlation with .corr(). Say that moving together does not show that one causes the other.
Never state a finding the code has not computed: write code that prints the result, run it, then quote what it printed.
report: I drew $what and saved it to $chart.
teach: The correlation is a number from -1 to 1: near 1 they rise together, near -1 one rises as the other falls, near 0 there is no pattern.
